test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 11 Mar 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Ina certain code language, MUSIC is coded as LATEB and TORRID as SUSQEF. How will DEBATE be coded?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

MUSIC is coded as LATEB

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6b5be66cb7af01db4c6d3791dc961b747301e82bcc67fa5cf1d0d47ee3d34f20.png] 

TORRID as SUSQEF.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f466fadf6713b4d103d9c3f06c1a7ee0804700ae9d0edaf4a11fa4e31bee2f49.png] 

Thus, 1st letter - 1; I ⇔ E; B ⇔ C; U ⇔ A; S ⇔ T

Similarly, **DEBATE **will be coded:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8296638e8df260aba06c7e4881bdc9e92c8de7346dbb16db28ccfb1f3e7f92ca.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"CICUSI".**
